content: RIFAMATE is a pharmaceutical preparation in capsule form that combines two active ingredients: 300 mg of rifampin and 150 mg of isoniazid. The capsules also include several inactive components, which are colloidal silicon dioxide, FD&C Blue No. 1, FD&C Red No. 40, gelatin, magnesium stearate, sodium starch glycolate, and titanium dioxide. Rifampin is a semisynthetic antibiotic that is chemically derived from rifamycin B. Its chemical name is 3-(4-methyl-1-piperazinyliminomethyl) rifamycin SV. Isoniazid, on the other hand, is the hydrazide derivative of isonicotinic acid. It appears as either colorless or white crystals, or as a white crystalline powder. This compound is water-soluble, odorless, and demonstrates slow degradation when exposed to air and light.
